jup_operators/jup_mp_alpha_bio: David \xe2\x80\x9cBBQ\xe2\x80\x9d Fischer was born to a military family in the heart of Texas with a lineage that went back generations. Service wasn\xe2\x80\x99t just an expectation - one couldn\xe2\x80\x99t consider themselves a Fischer without it. David spent many weekends listening to his veteran uncles and grandfathers\xe2\x80\x99 stories and shooting with them in the yard, but he would always make time to join his mother and grandmother before supper, learning decades worth of recipes they were eager to share. By the time he joined the Marines, David had been honed into the ideal squad mate. Not only was he a dedicated, professional soldier, but David could always be counted on for a story, a laugh, or some good eats. He often made comfort dishes for friends and officers alike, earning the friendship and loyalty of everyone who served alongside him. It didn\xe2\x80\x99t take long for the brass to notice him. Now, David is a veteran officer in the Marines with multiple deployments across South Asia and the Middle East. He\xe2\x80\x99s fulfilled his family legacy as a beloved officer, often taking new marines under his wing and looking out for them in the field. But back at base, you\xe2\x80\x99ll find "BBQ\xe2\x80\x9d eagerly helping in the field kitchen, same as he always did back in Texas.

jup_operators/jup_mp_beta_bio: The son of Duke Leto, young Paul Atreides was born into a destiny greater than his royal title. His fate is to travel across the stars to the most dangerous planet in the Known Universe: Dune. jup_operators/jup_mp_beta_desc: From the desert war zone of Dune, Paul Atreides arrives in Call of Duty\xc2\xae armed with ^2crysknife^7 and ^2Maula Pistol^7 ^5Blueprints^7 destined to unleash vengeance on the battlefield.
jup_operators/jup_mp_bike_bio:
After the outbreak, Michonne suffered the devastating loss of her son, Andre. She retreated inwards and focused solely on survival. Over time, she found a new group and bonded with them, especially Rick and his son, Carl. She has endured much since the world changed, but those experiences have forged her into a post-apocalyptic expert, whose intuition and combat skills are second-to-none.

After Rick\xe2\x80\x99s disappearance, Michonne went on to lead the survivors of the Alexandria Safe Zone and continued to push for a democratic society built on steady optimism and peace. She will always fight for her family against tyranny, and the desire for the days ahead to be better than those she leaves behind.
jup_operators/jup_mp_bike_desc: Michonne is a warrior and a survivor. Deep and traumatic loss pushed her into solitude, where she honed her skills with a katana. Now she uses it to defend her new family against all threats.

jup_operators/jup_mp_bravo_bio:
Raised in rural Urzikstan, Samara \xe2\x80\x9cPathfinder\xe2\x80\x9d Jalal is a master tracker with the ULF who fought to expel the rogue Russian forces from her country. On her family's farm and homestead, Samara\xe2\x80\x99s parents taught her how to hunt and traverse the land. But when General Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s soldiers arrived, Samara and her mother set fire to the fields rather than give them food or shelter. Samara was arrested; her mother was shot.

She was brought to a prison camp where she met other girls and women who dared resist Barkov. A group of them, led by Farah Karim, spent two years planning their escape, with Samara to act as their guide once they were out. Unfortunately, the guards learned of their plan and the conspirators were tortured and separated. Samara was sent clear across the country to a prison camp in unfamiliar terrain. She slowly mapped out the area and took a dozen others with her as she fled into the wilderness. Samara was ecstatic to finally be free.

Samara made her way back home, ready to protect it with everything she had. But there was hardly anything left \xe2\x80\x93 her father had died in her absence, and the farm was in ruins. Instead, she lived off the land, taking out rogue Russian soldiers whenever she came across them. When she heard of Farah\xe2\x80\x99s escape, she ran to join her in the fight. Farah put Samara in charge of training an elite ULF scouting unit. Samara and her unit have relayed intelligence information about troop movements and targets to Commander Karim over the last decade with courage and optimism. Now, with a family to protect, she fights for her children grow up in a peaceful Urzikstan, one free from Russian ultranationalist forces.

Rhea Ripley is a cold-blooded killer forged in the fires of brutal combat. This Aussie nightmare slashed her way through the ranks, dominating the Mae Young Classic and the inaugural NXT UK Women's Championship Tournament.

The Nightmare's list of accolades only grew as she reached the main roster. After an awe-inspiring showing during the 2019 Women's Royal Rumble Match, Ripley shocked the world by ending Asuka's reign of terror in the Raw Women's Championship Match at WrestleMania 37.

The ultra-aggressive and terrifyingly strong Aussie embraced her true self, and that spelled bad news for anyone who faced her, as she already had the physical goods to stand toe-to-toe with any Superstar in sports entertainment.

Now unleashed on the battlefield, Rhea Ripley embraces her role as an agent of torment and fear. Merciless, dominant, and seemingly unstoppable - this is the embodiment of a true Nightmare.
jup_operators/jup_mp_caramel_desc: Those unfortunate enough to face Mami on the battlefield know the oppressive dread of her unstoppable onslaught.
hash_2f21670fcb5c6186:
First appearing in Miles County on Halloween night, this demonic entity quickly established himself as a force of pure evil, leaving behind a path of bloody murders.

Art is marked by an unmistakable look \xe2\x80\x93 a black and white clown outfit, featuring a white and black painted demonic/devilish face and his expressions alternating between wide grins and menacing sneers. He employs extreme violence often through diverse weapons and instruments to creatively kill his victims using more gruesome methods as his crimes continue.

He has supernatural powers including apparent immortality. Even when seemingly fatally wounded, he survives such injuries coming back always again to reign terror.

Art does not speak but uses exaggerated expressions and gestures instead. This makes him even more creepy since he silently moves around like a predator stalking its prey while having that sick sense of humor present in clowns.

His targets seem random, but he seems particularly captivated by young women whom he often torments for extensive periods before killing them. His acts are not just murder; they are meticulously staged performances of cruelty that mirror his deranged clown character way of life.
hash_73912ce838b4d5c1: Become the silent slasher known as Art the Clown.

hash_5adcb3f2354594a2:
To the unsuspecting, Sam might seem like just another kid out trick-or-treating, but there's nothing sweet about what's lurking beneath his eerie costume. His burlap sack mask hides a truly sinister face, and while his pumpkin lollipop and chocolate candy bar might look tasty, when wielded by Sam, they both quickly become deadly weapons.

Sam acts as judge, jury, and executioner for those who break the rules and traditions of the holiday, so if he shows up at your door this Halloween, you'd better be in costume and armed with a bowl full of treats\xe2\x80\x94because if not, you might be in for one hell of a trick.

Sam\xe2\x80\x99s Rules of Halloween:

1. Wear a costume.
2. Pass out treats.
3. Never blow out a jack-o\xe2\x80\x99-lantern.
4. And ALWAYS check your candy.

Daryl Dixon learned from an early age that survival often means relying on oneself. Growing up in a dysfunctional family with an alcoholic father and an unreliable older brother, Daryl developed a keen sense of self-reliance and adaptability. His difficult upbringing left him with excellent survival skills, but poor social skills and a deep-seated mistrust of others.

Before the outbreak, Daryl lived a solitary life in the woods of Georgia with his brother Merle. He had no steady job and often followed his brother\xe2\x80\x99s lead engaging in illicit activities. After the fall, Daryl and Merle were separated when Merle was left handcuffed on a rooftop. Daryl joined Rick on an unsuccessful mission to rescue Merle, and later formed strong bonds within the group, particularly with Carol Peletier and Rick himself.

Now, as chaos engulfs the world, Daryl stands ready to use his unique skillset to navigate the dangers that lurk around every corner. Whether stalking targets through dense forests or defending strategic positions in urban warfare, Daryl remains an unpredictable and formidable force.

A talented athlete from a young age with dreams of winning medals on the world stage, Gytha \xe2\x80\x9cAlpine\xe2\x80\x9d Stromme wears the uniform of the Jegertroppen with pride. Born in Lillehammer, Gytha was always in motion, whether she was skiing down slopes, shooting targets out of the air, or impressing judges in gymnastics. In high school, she had aspirations to medal in skiing at the highest level. But shortly before tryouts, an accident left her with a broken leg and stalled ambitions. 

The healing process was long and grueling, but Gytha was determined to return to full form. By the time she was fully healed, Gytha was called to serve in Norway\xe2\x80\x99s mandatory military service. She found herself acclimating to the military routine very well, easily keeping up with the harsh physical requirements. Seeing her natural talent, a mentor recommended that Gytha try to join the Jegertroppen, an elite all-female special forces unit.  

As a member of the Jegertroppen, Gytha specializes in gathering intelligence from civilian women and has seen more than her fair share of combat. Her partner, a member of the same unit, has told Gytha that she should go for a gold in skiing again one day, but Gytha is content with her work as it is. While a military career was not something "Alpine" had envisioned for herself initially, she finds her work with the Jegertroppen liberating and takes pride in her role as both civilian mediator and soldier.

jup_operators/jup_mp_gelato_bio:
Born into wrestling royalty as the son of the late WWE Hall of Famer "The American Dream" Dusty Rhodes, "The American Nightmare" Cody Rhodes was destined for greatness. He honed his skills for years, capturing multiple titles in WWE from 2007 to 2016 by capturing two Intercontinental Championships and six WWE Tag Team Championships before departing to forge his own path.

But The American Nightmare refused to stay away, making a heroic return at WrestleMania 38 to answer Seth "Freakin" Rollins's open challenge. Despite suffering a torn pectoral, Cody's perseverance saw him defeat The Visionary twice, solidifying his status as one of the most tenacious and resilient competitors in the game. At WrestleMania XL, Cody achieved his destiny, dethroning Roman Reigns to claim the Undisputed WWE Championship.

Boasting a dangerous arsenal and a tremendous knowledge of the squared circle, Rhodes battled everyone from Randy Orton to The Miz to Rey Mysterio and so many more. Now, this wrestling legacy carries his family name into battle. Blessed with an arsenal of punishing maneuvers and a psychotic level of toughness, The American Nightmare has arrived - underestimate him at your peril.
jup_operators/jup_mp_gelato_desc: Summon the unrelenting onslaught of The American Nightmare dynasty and watch as the opposition's resolve crumbles under the weight of the Nightmare's reality.

A former spy and current interrogation specialist, Clyde \xe2\x80\x9cBantam\xe2\x80\x9d Hogan has always been a natural troublemaker with a short fuse. Raised in the Scottish coastal town of Dundee, Clyde would pick fights with anyone who looked at him funny, then start mouthing off at the biggest kids he could find. The only person he never lost his cool with was his mother, a kind but sickly woman who raised Clyde to the best of her ability. They made it a weekly tradition to watch the newest spy movies every Friday, a tradition Clyde wouldn\xe2\x80\x99t miss for the world.

As Clyde turned 16, he dropped out of school, eager to provide for his mother, and enlisted in the British Armed Forces. He was a natural, easily juggling both mundane routines and improvisation, and the army taught him some sorely needed self-control. Clyde caught the attention of MI6, who scouted him as a potential field agent. While initially hesitant to abandon the simplicity of the army, Clyde knew the bigger paycheck would let him send more money back home.

Clyde \xe2\x80\x9cBantam\xe2\x80\x9d Hogan joined MI6\xe2\x80\x99s agent pool and spent his 20s on assignments across Europe, living out the spy thrillers of his youth. But his temper often caused issues, and he was eventually discharged from MI6 after punching a diplomat for bad mouthing his mother. With over ten years of military intelligence experience under his belt, Clyde turned to the private sector. As an interrogator, "Bantam\xe2\x80\x9d tackles both domestic and international threats and no one tries to put a leash on his temper anymore.
jup_operators/jup_mp_gulag_10_desc: Pop your collar and show 'em who's boss.
jup_operators/jup_mp_gulag_bio:
A veteran Konni operative, Ivan Alexxeve was loyal to the people, and to the cause.

Ivan Alexxeve was the scariest man in the room. In his young and impressionable youth, Ivan spent time with his father in New York City, witnessing a world of espionage and deceit. He took some hard lessons back to Russia, where he carried on his family\xe2\x80\x99s decorated military legacy in his own military career, climbing the ranks with sheer determination and physicality.

His distrust and dislike of the West eventually led him to the Konni Group, where he met and aligned himself with Makarov in the hopes of dismantling and disproving the West\xe2\x80\x99s notion of being the most powerful military in the world.

While Ivan and Makarov shared the goal of the West\xe2\x80\x99s defeat and Russia\xe2\x80\x99s rise, they disagreed on the treatment of soldiers. Ivan understood loyalty to be a two-way street between commander and soldier, but misunderstood his own importance to Makarov.

When Ivan became frustrated at Makarov\xe2\x80\x99s callous treatment of his soldiers, knowing firsthand what it\xe2\x80\x99s like to be pushed and abused by your superiors for unimaginable results, Makarov watched Ivan's loyalty falter... and he did not like what he saw.

For questioning his leader, and wasting time, Ivan was executed by Makarov at a Konni base in 2023.
jup_operators/jup_mp_gulag_desc: A veteran Konni operative, Ivan Alexxeve was loyal to the people, and to the cause.

Manoel was the youngest of three siblings by a large margin. Growing up, he was often called the \xe2\x80\x9caccident,\xe2\x80\x9d though his father would assure him that yes, he may have been an accident, but he was a happy one.

When Manoel was twelve-years-old, and his siblings long gone from the home, his father gifted him a puppy \xe2\x80\x93 a Brazilian mastiff, to name and care for.

Manoel named the puppy Hammer, and they did everything together. Wanting to be with Hammer for as long as possible, Manoel trained him as a working dog, and enrolled in the military with Hammer by his side. First, he was part of the Guard Battalion utilizing Hammer as a guard dog, and later, moved his way into the Brazil Special Operations where Hammer\xe2\x80\x99s hunting and tracking skills became invaluable in chasing down targets.

One day, on a tracking mission, Hammer was killed in action by the SpecGru organization. Manoel took Hammer's name as his own callsign, and vowed revenge. He joined KorTac to do it and promised to never work with another K-9 unit, and to avenge his dog.
jup_operators/jup_mp_hammer_desc: Guard, track, hunt, and drop the Hammer.

Once a mercenary drawn to Zakhaev\xe2\x80\x99s promises, Ziryan \xe2\x80\x9cScorch\xe2\x80\x9d Serhati-Hadid is now an aged fighter driven to right the wrongs of his past. He was born into a poor Urzikstani family that lost everything during the Russian occupation to bombs and raiding. One day his parents left to scavenge for food and never returned  \xe2\x80\x93 he never found out what had happened to them. Life was tough on him, so he had to be even tougher, becoming fast on his feet and faster with his hands. The moment he was old enough, he joined the Urzikstan Liberation Force (ULF) to fight against the country's oppressors and put his only skills to use.  

He proved an agile and adept soldier with an uncanny skill with a gun. But fighting Russia was an endless, thankless task that couldn\xe2\x80\x99t even guarantee a meal every day. Ziryan\xe2\x80\x99s sense of national pride was secondary to his desire to never go hungry again. Hearing of his skill, Zakhaev of Terminus Outcomes approached him with an offer of promotion and riches beyond anything he\xe2\x80\x99d ever encountered. It was an easy choice - Ziryan abandoned the ULF and was a part of the initial strike team that led to the creation of the Exclusion Zone.  

But after seeing the horror wrought upon his homeland by Zakhaev, and realizing that he had been a part of that destructive force, Ziryan defected. He sought out opportunities to strike back, and was brought onto Operation Deadbolt. Though he retains his mercenary mindset, "Scorch\xe2\x80\x9d is no longer willing to sell his services to men like Zakhaev and tries to undo some of the harm he did in his youth.

jup_operators/jup_mp_judo_bio:
After being shot in the line of duty, Sheriff\xe2\x80\x99s Deputy Rick Grimes awoke from a coma to find the world irrevocably changed. He traveled through this new apocalyptic wasteland, first to find his family, and later in search of a safe and secure home for them. His combat skills and strong moral center catapulted him into a position of leadership among the survivors, with whom he quickly formed strong familial bonds \xe2\x80\x93 none more so than Michonne.

Rick will not hesitate to act against any threat to his group, be it human or walker. He puts his people first, and though he is battle-hardened and at times overwhelmed by this harsh new reality, his dream of rebuilding civilization and paving the way for a better future never wavers. Rick is a heroic figure to his people \xe2\x80\x93 one that continues to sacrifice everything for those he loves.
jup_operators/jup_mp_judo_desc: A former Sheriff\xe2\x80\x99s Deputy with a strong moral code, Rick is a battle - hardened survivor who will stop at nothing to protect his people.

Ateret Dahan was never supposed to go into the military \xe2\x80\x93 she was supposed to marry young and start on a family. That was the plan that her strict religious family laid out for her, following in the footsteps of her mother and sisters. But Ateret began to question the plan after her new husband died in a car accident, leaving her widowed before she turned 20.

In the middle of this crisis of faith and identity, Ateret joined the IDF \xe2\x80\x93 the first in her family to serve, in spite of their religious exemption. Within their ranks, Ateret found community in the other young women serving beside her, women with goals and dreams of their own, women who inspired her to find and follow her own passions. It wasn\xe2\x80\x99t until she was running across the battlefield and dodging a hailstorm of bullets to drag her fallen comrades back to safety and tend to their wounds that she realized what that passion was: combat medicine.\xc2\xa0

Ateret \xe2\x80\x9cDoc\xe2\x80\x9d Dahan serves with Special Tactics Rescue, getting dozens of soldiers the medical care they need both in the field and as they fly back to safety. Esteemed for her courage during battle and dedication to saving lives; \xe2\x80\x9cDoc\xe2\x80\x9d is a symbol of hope for wounded and weary soldiers, a reassuring presence that spurs them forward.

jup_operators/jup_mp_kappa_bio:
Orla Murphy grew up as one of six children in a working-class home in Dublin. With her parents always busy, Orla spent most of her youth following her older brothers around and helping them get into trouble. While her delinquency started with minor vandalism and petty theft, it eventually expanded to joy riding and robbery.

Orla was eventually caught behind the wheel of a stolen car, but since she was still a minor, she was sent to a Children\xe2\x80\x99s Detention Facility. The intention was to straighten her out, and for a time it worked. Once she turned 18, Orla joined the Defence Forces. She excelled with the routine of military life and thrived in a team dynamic, but the salary failed to impress her.

Orla started doing off-the-books jobs while deployed: smuggling contraband, taking kickbacks to look the other way when she was on guard duty. All of which quickly put her on the military tribunal radar, despite her best efforts. However, she\xe2\x80\x99d also attracted the attention of KorTac, who approved of Orla\xe2\x80\x99s tendencies to bend the rules and dirty her hands. Following her discharge, KorTac was quick to offer her a mercenary contract to simply be herself.
jup_operators/jup_mp_kappa_desc: A natural scrapper, Orla Murphy always finds a way to get what she wants.
jup_operators/jup_mp_kilo_10_desc: The hunter's path consists of three things. Blood, sweat, and trophies.
jup_operators/jup_mp_kilo_14_desc: Wreak havoc and win battles. It's in your DNA.
jup_operators/jup_mp_kilo_bio:
Izolda \xe2\x80\x9cWarden\xe2\x80\x9d Garanina believes that Russia will only be safe when it has subjugated the rest of the world, and has joined Konni to help make that a reality. She was born into a privileged life as the daughter of Kremlin officials, political activists fighting for a better future. Her parents taught her that Russia was a nation with a rich history, that it could be changed from within for the better. Unfortunately, her parents were casualties in an extremist attack against the Russian state, an attack Izolda only survived thanks to her parents\xe2\x80\x99 sacrifice.

Orphaned and broken, thirteen-year-old Izolda was taken in by her aunt, a political agitator with much more militant views than those of Izolda\xe2\x80\x99s parents. Over the next five years, the vulnerable Izolda slowly adopted her aunt\xe2\x80\x99s dogma that strong military action was Russia\xe2\x80\x99s only hope for a better future, and surrounded herself only with others who shared that view. With encouragement and a recommendation from her aunt, Izolda joined the Russian Armed Forces as soon as she was able.

Naturally bright and burning with determination, Izolda excelled, quickly earning a spot in the elite Vympel unit, conducting both counterterrorism and infiltration operations. But the Armed Forces were not bold enough for Izolda \xe2\x80\x93 they were too reactionary. Izolda believed that the only safe and prosperous Russia was one that took charge of all world affairs. She joined the Konni Group looking for a leader who was willing to take measures even her aunt wouldn\xe2\x80\x99t and, in Makarov, "Warden\xe2\x80\x9d found that in spades.
jup_operators/jup_mp_kilo_vault_desc: Death has no limits, no remorse, and no regrets. Nemesis Warden doesn't either.

Raised on a farm towards the outskirts of Mogadishu, Bashiir spent much of his early life working the fields with his father and brothers. But with famine quickly spreading across Somalia, Bashiir and his brothers began searching elsewhere for work. While most of his siblings would begin fishing in the port of Baraawe, Bashiir sought for the city of Mogadishu and began earning a wage as a security guard. Lost in the clamor of the huge city, Bashiir learned the rules of survival the hard way after a near fatal slashing that left him with terrible scars that still itch.

Furious at his own naivety and helplessness, Bashiir adapted to the chaos of the city, learning both the street smarts necessary for survival and the skills to defend himself with ease. Within a year, Bashiir\xe2\x80\x99s name was known throughout Mogadishu as a reliable and effective fixer. At the age of 24, Bashiir attracted the attention of a KorTac recruiter scouting for potential recruits in Mogadishu. Promised a wage far beyond anything he or his family had ever seen, Bashiir enlisted with KorTac and began his journey as an international mercenary.

Bashiir\xe2\x80\x99s career has taken him from the sands of Mali to the jungles of the Congo, developing his skills far beyond that of a city fixer. Now he stands among KorTac\xe2\x80\x99s finest, a soldier for the highest bidder among KorTac\xe2\x80\x99s clientele. While the specifics of his contract are unknown, the locals of Baraawe often say the rest of the Shirwa family never have to work another day in their lives.
jup_operators/jup_mp_lambda_desc: Once a simple farmhand thrust into the chaos of Mogadishu, Bashiir Shirwa was forged in the city\xe2\x80\x99s fire and became its most capable agent.

jup_operators/jup_mp_laswell_bio:
Laswell was born in Annapolis, Maryland. Though she started out as a communications analyst with an increasingly impressive aptitude for strategic analysis, Kate discovered her true calling after her transfer to the U.S. Africa Command at Camp Lemonnier. There, the base became ground zero in a suicide bomber attack, with her survival sparking her devotion to a career in global security.

In climbing the CIA ranks, Laswell was called to supervise a Special Activities Division (SAD) "black site" program in Europe, Asia and South America; the first woman to ever do so. Though her position was considered controversial, Laswell remained a respected figure, strategically utilizing reliable maneuvers to both risk, and save, lives; whatever it took to get the job done.

Laswell is a direct report of the Inspector General of the CIA, and she maintains Top Secret clearance. With her authorization of select special agents, like Alex Keller, as well as her working relationship with Captain John Price and 141, Laswell's played a pivotal role in countless covert missions aimed at neutralizing terrorism worldwide. In 2022 Laswell returned to the field, in pursuit of American missiles ambushed by Konni group operatives, resulting in her kidnapping. During her rescue she killed several of her captors in close-range hand to hand combat.

Kate's remarkable ability to decipher complex threats through information warfare strategies, coupled with decades of specialization and unyielding commitment to counterinsurgency makes her a critical resource in every phase of mission planning and execution.
jup_operators/jup_mp_laswell_desc: Agent Laswell returns to the field in deadly form. Unfortunately for her enemies, she hasn't lost her touch.

Born in Paris, \xc3\x89lodie Michaux was raised by her mother and four tough, streetwise older brothers. While her brothers tried their hardest to keep \xc3\x89lodie straight, she came to idolize and imitate them instead. By the time she was ten, \xc3\x89lodie developed tough skin and light fingers, from stealing cigarettes from the store, to robbing tourists at knifepoint. The rare times she was caught, a young \xc3\x89lodie charmed her way out of any serious consequences.  

While her brothers straightened out as they got older with all four enlisting in the army, \xc3\x89lodie was still up to the same tricks. Until her crimes \xe2\x80\x93 and the police \xe2\x80\x93 eventually caught up with her. \xc3\x89lodie\xe2\x80\x99s brothers bailed her out and staged an intervention. Out of love for them, \xc3\x89lodie committed to going straight. When she came of age, \xc3\x89lodie followed her brothers into the military, quickly proving herself and joining the demolitions specialists within the 1er R\xc3\xa9giment de Parachutistes d'Infanterie de Marine. With her light touch, \xc3\x89lodie became their go-to EOD operative, though she saw plenty of combat and blew up more than her fair share of adversaries. 

While her time in the military began pleasantly, over the next five years, three of her brothers would die in action, with one brother left severely disabled. Disillusioned with army life, \xc3\x89lodie left the military. But with her mother and remaining brother still to care for, she turned to \xe2\x80\x98friends\xe2\x80\x99 from the old days on the streets, who asked for help with an art heist. \xc3\x89lodie, with skills in disarmament, explosives, and thievery, agreed. Since then, \xc3\x89lodie \xe2\x80\x9cLockpick\xe2\x80\x9d Michaux has become a common name in the criminal underground, using her reputation and skills to support her family. The more jobs she does, the more others hear about her skills, and the better the jobs become.

Ari was born in South Korea to a family of gifted engineers. She spent her days tinkering with advanced gadgets her parents would bring home from their lab. Ari took an interest in computers and would go on to earn degrees in both computer science and engineering from the prestigious Seoul University, eventually setting her up for a position in R&D for the South Korean Military.

As Ari\xe2\x80\x99s service in the military went on, she was eventually recruited for her expertise into a covert special forces unit within the South Korean Military. It was here she trained in robotics and developed a keen skill for hacking even the most impenetrable firewalls. Her skills proved worthy enough for one of the most dangerous assignments in special forces at the time: infiltrating North Korea.

Ari used her hacking skills and advanced drones to survey and take classified information back to the South. But when her cover was blown, she was forced to flee and don a new identity. Tired of hiding from North Korean agents, she hacked into the South Korean Military\xe2\x80\x99s private contacts and found the global KorTac Faction. Convinced this was an opportunity to emerge from the shadows and get back into the fight for sovereignty across the globe, she offered them her services in exchange for a new life.

jup_operators/jup_mp_makarov_bio:
Vladimir Makarov was born before the fall of the Soviet Union in the suburbs of Moscow. As the son of a high-ranking politician within the Russian government, Makarov watched the Soviet Union crumble, taking his father with it. The bright eyed, intelligent boy woke up one morning to his father\xe2\x80\x99s hanging body. Makarov came to despise his father's weakness, as well as the failures of the Soviet Union which had brought it about. He vowed not to make the same mistakes and so began his lifelong obsession.
In 1998, Makarov joined the Russian military at the age of 18. A natural soldier with a talent for strategy, his reputation turned sour when he joined forces with an unsanctioned rogue army to maintain control of Urzikstan. When the ULF rose and took back their home, Makarov experienced his first failure.

Recognizing traces of the Soviet Union\xe2\x80\x99s failures once again, Makarov pleaded with his superiors to reclaim Urzikstan, disgusted by the international mockery the ULF had made of Russian power. But the Kremlin, who had not sanctioned the attack on Urzikstan to begin with, refused, stripping the radical Makarov of all military honors. Seeking justice, Makarov joined the Konni group and plotted an attack against Verdansk to get Russia\xe2\x80\x99s attention. Captured by Captain John Price and Task Force 141, Makarov was handed to Russian authorities and sentenced to life in a maximum-security gulag.

Now a liberated man, Makarov plans to resume his operations against Urzikstan and its allies. Determined to redeem himself and Russia for its past failures, Makarov will only stop at the full reclamation or annihilation of Urzikstan; and if the Kremlin\xe2\x80\x99s too cowardly to play their hand, he'll gladly force it upon the rest of the world.

jup_operators/jup_mp_mike_bio:
Mike \xe2\x80\x9cJabber\xe2\x80\x9d Yuan has spent much more of his life abroad than he\xe2\x80\x99s ever spent at home, and that\xe2\x80\x99s exactly how he likes it. Mike was born in Rhode Island into a Chinese immigrant family with a prosperous civil engineering firm. With clients around the globe, they traveled often to oversee their largest projects; by the time he started middle school, Mike had spent eight years in six countries, He enjoyed the challenge of learning a new language quickly enough to make friends. His family moved back to Rhode Island for good when Mike started high school. He hated being stuck in one place for so long. After graduation, to the horror of his parents, Mike immediately enlisted in the military, thinking that it would be the easiest way to travel the world again.

It\xe2\x80\x99s been fifteen years since then, but Mike doesn\xe2\x80\x99t regret his decision one bit. Making sure people understand one another on the ground saves lives \xe2\x80\x93 he's seen it. He\xe2\x80\x99s spent the past few years on Delta Force, working in counterterrorism and hostage rescue. Between the soldiers he trains, the civilians he works with, the new locations he travels to, and the new languages he\xe2\x80\x99s tasked with learning, he hasn't been bored in fifteen years.

Mike\xe2\x80\x99s words are his superpower - he's talented at getting people to talk with him and listen to him, and he can usually win them over quickly. For those he can\xe2\x80\x99t win over with words... there\xe2\x80\x99s combat, which Mike expertly maneuvers as he clearly and effectively communicates to his teammates under fire. Thriving under pressure and always eager for a new challenge or change of pace, you can always count on \xe2\x80\x9cJabber\xe2\x80\x9d to tackle it head on.
hash_aa7453caed3748f: Become a classic film icon with this special ^3Operator Skin^7.
hash_1bcba55ed4a02652:
Born in the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois, the life of Michael Myers took a dark turn at the age of six when he inexplicably murdered his older sister on Halloween in 1963. Following this tragedy, Michael was institutionalized at Smith's Grove Sanitarium, where he remained for 15 years under the care of child psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis. During this time, Michael never spoke a word. Dr. Loomis, initially optimistic about Michael's treatment, grew to believe that his patient was pure evil, devoid of any humanity.

Michael escaped from the sanitarium on October 30th, 1978, and on Halloween night began stalking a high school student named Laurie Strode. Wearing a pale, expressionless mask and blue coveralls Michael relentlessly pursued Laurie throughout the night, killing her friends and anyone who got in his way. Despite being injured multiple times by both Loomis and Laurie, Michael continued his pursuit, seemingly indestructible.

The events of Halloween 1978 cemented Michael Myers' legacy as one of the most terrifying figures in Haddonfield's history. His silence, his apparent lack of motive beyond pure evil, and his unstoppable nature make him the embodiment of mindless, motiveless malignancy - a boogeyman come to life.

jup_operators/jup_mp_mochi_bio:
He stands only 5-foot-6 and barely weighs 175 pounds, but a lack of size hasn\xe2\x80\x99t stopped the incomparable Rey Mysterio from achieving giant dreams in WWE, including capturing the WWE Championship, two World Heavyweight Championships, two Intercontinental Championships, three United States Championships, five WWE Tag Team Championships, three WWE Cruiserweight Championships, and outlasting 29 other Superstars to win the Royal Rumble Match as the No. 2 entrant.

Whether standing up to a dangerous giant like Kane or flying down from the top of a steel cage, the Ultimate Underdog is known for refusing to be intimidated inside the ring. Trained in the proud Mexican tradition of lucha libre before he was even old enough to drive, Rey Mysterio adopted his ring name in tribute to his uncle and hid his face under a mask as lucha custom dictates.

First establishing himself in the cruiserweight and tag team divisions, the Mexican Superstar soon proved that size doesn\xe2\x80\x99t matter when he beat the odds to win the Royal Rumble Match in 2006. From there, Mysterio accomplished the inconceivable when he won the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania XXII, becoming the smallest Superstar ever to hold that title.
With his revolutionary style, Mysterio overcame the odds to enjoy a championship career that is respected by fellow Superstars and the WWE Universe alike, making him one of the most well-known and beloved competitors of all time. Defy the odds and shatter expectations by joining the Master of the 619 as he brings his heart, determination, and an endless supply of high-impact aerial insanity to the warzone.
jup_operators/jup_mp_mochi_desc: Let the aerial insanity commence as the Ultimate Underdog. Rey Mysterio brings his revolutionary lucha libre style to the battlegrounds.

Recently anointed as Vladimir Makarov\xe2\x80\x99s right hand man, Captain Andrei Nolan executes both plans and enemies with ferocious precision in the name of igniting a long-awaited war between East and West. In his youth, Nolan idolized the great men of history, those who had changed the world with a mixture of strategy, charisma, and violence. He immersed himself in their battle plans, strategic maneuvers, speeches and ideas. When he was seventeen, he joined the Australian Defense Forces, wanting to take part in the making of history.

Nolan excelled, becoming a squad leader with a reputation for brutality and consistency. He was quickly admitted into the Special Forces of Australia, where his team conducted anti-terrorism and peacekeeping operations throughout the Pacific. Eventually, Nolan left Australia\xe2\x80\x99s armed forces for the private sector, bouncing between various PMCs for years, before he was approached by Ivan Alexxeve. Ivan saw in Nolan a man who couldn\xe2\x80\x99t be bought \xe2\x80\x93 his respect and loyalty had to be earned by someone worthy, with strength of will and vision. That made Nolan a perfect candidate for The Inner Circle, an ultranationalist movement led by a tactical genius called Vladimir Makarov.

Nolan saw in Makarov everything he admired about the great men of the past \xe2\x80\x93 the strategic brilliance, the electric charisma, and the capacity to enact change through violence. Nolan carried out orders with his trademark efficiency and viciousness and Makarov took notice, bringing Nolan into his confidence. After Makarov\xe2\x80\x99s incarceration, Nolan, Ivan, and other Inner Circle members joined a PMC called the Konni Group to sow the seeds for Makarov\xe2\x80\x99s return to power. In securing Makarov\xe2\x80\x99s freedom, Captain Andrei Nolan\xe2\x80\x99s unwavering loyalty earned him the top spot of Makarov\xe2\x80\x99s most trusted advisor and enforcer. He will faithfully ignite as many fires necessary until war between East and West finally explodes.

A former Rangers Training Battalion instructor and current squad leader, Isa \xe2\x80\x9cByline\xe2\x80\x9d Juarez started her military career off in journalism. A native of Maywood CA and daughter of Oaxacan immigrants, Isa started writing for her school paper because she wanted something to boost her college transcript. But Isa was never good at doing things halfway \xe2\x80\x93 if she was in, she was all in, and journalism became her passion. She went on to join the ROTC, eager to embrace the world of military journalism while earning her tuition. She embraced the military routine with the same dedication she\xe2\x80\x99d shown to journalism, and quickly became a star student.

Before Isa graduated, news broke of the first women to successfully make it through Ranger training. As Isa covered the story, she felt a connection to the single-minded resolve of these women. Seeing that same resolve within herself, she set her sights on the same goal and threw herself fully into training. She passed her second time through Ranger School \xe2\x80\x93 failure would never deter Isa from achieving her goals.

Isa stayed with the Rangers after earning her tab as part of the 4th RTB, guiding others through the same course. She developed a reputation as a straightforward instructor who took great pride in raising others up, taking special interest in helping other women succeed. After a few years, looking for a fresh challenge, Isa transferred to an infantry unit deployed throughout Southeast Asia and the Middle East as a squad leader. The unit relies on guidance and leadership from \xe2\x80\x9cByline\xe2\x80\x9d, as well as her journalistic talent for asking the right questions.

Without anyone to stop the cartel in their remote Costa Rican fishing town, Ricardo could only watch as the cartel ruined lives and worked his father to the bone for years. However, Ricardo\xe2\x80\x99s prayers were answered when the SIU arrived in force, arresting the cartel members, freeing his father, and liberating the town from the cartel\xe2\x80\x99s influence. jup_operators/jup_mp_papa_bio: Abe Kaede grew up in a small town on the shores of Okinawa, raised by her grandparents. While most children her age were focused on school or sports, Kaede was drawn to planes. Watching the way they cut through the clouds and zoomed across the horizon, Kaede often dreamed about soaring across the sky, far above the Okinawan sand. Towards her teenage years, Kaede revealed herself to be something of a thrill seeker. She took dares, made bets and did increasingly dangerous stunts; constantly worrying her grandparents. Through the occasional \xe2\x80\x9cborrowing\xe2\x80\x9d of others\xe2\x80\x99 vehicles, she learned how to drive a variety of different modes of transit \xe2\x80\x93 motorcycles, boats, lorries. As soon as she was of age, she got her long-awaited pilot's license, nearly losing it a few times following some reckless piloting. It was a carefree life. But when her grandparents got into a bad car accident and had to stop working, Kaede stepped up and decided it was time to grow up and provide for her family. She signed up for the JASDF and while she began as a helicopter transport pilot, Abe Kaede \xe2\x80\x93 known as \xe2\x80\x9cJet\xe2\x80\x9d - became one of the first women invited to train for their fighter pilot's license. Never one to back down from a challenge, Kaede jumped at the chance and the rest is history. Now an ace pilot for the JASDF, Kaede soars through the sky with a daring and precision only she could pull off.

jup_operators/jup_mp_quebec_bio: GTI sergeant Ph\xe1\xba\xa1m L\xc3\xa2n Minh has always had a knack for puzzles. Whether he was solving puzzles or fiddling with brain teasers, nothing satisfied him more than when a puzzle finally \xe2\x80\x9cclicked.\xe2\x80\x9d But not long after his family moved to Quebec, he and his mother found themselves in the middle of an armed robbery. Frightened for his life, L\xc3\xa2n Minh could do nothing but watch as things escalated into a hostage situation. There was no easy solution that he could spot. However, the Groupe tactique d'intervention (GTI) arrived with a plan. With a sniper drawing the robbers\xe2\x80\x99 attention, the GTI burst through various entry points in unison, quickly and non-lethally resolving the situation. The young L\xc3\xa2n Minh was inspired by the GTI\xe2\x80\x99s efficiency, their carefully thought-out method of attack, the sharpness of execution, and professionalism. Excited at the prospect of saving lives with the same skills he had spent years honing, Lan Minh dedicated himself to becoming a member of the GTI. He passed their entrance examination with flying colors at the age of 20. He\xe2\x80\x99s spent his career defusing hostage situations and neutralizing terrorist attacks. Now an experienced GTI sergeant, Ph\xe1\xba\xa1m L\xc3\xa2n Minh - known as \xe2\x80\x9cEnigma\xe2\x80\x9d - approaches every situation like a puzzle, considering all potential approaches and variables to keep Quebec safe.

jup_operators/jup_mp_romeo_bio:
The eldest of eight, Ben was born in American Samoa, surrounded by water in the \xe2\x80\x9cCradle of Polynesia\xe2\x80\x9d, where he learned to hunt, swim, endure the elements, and thrive. At a young age, it fell on him to provide for his siblings, and protect them. It was a responsibility he accepted with courage, and a burden which yielded accountability, selflessness and self-discipline \xe2\x80\x94 skills that would serve him well throughout his career as a United States Navy SEAL. 

At age ten, the culture shock of being uprooted from his island home and relocated to the Midwest provided the opportunity to diversify, grow, and develop. His family moved a dozen times before finishing high school, offering the chance for him to continually adapt and evolve. His performance as an athlete became social currency, his life thus far appearing tailor-made for the Teams. But the adversity of BUD/S is something no amount of living can prepare one for, and a severe injury cut his experience short the first time through. With perseverance he recovered, trained, reentered the program in a new class, and graduated. 

Over 16 years of service he deployed to Europe, Africa, Afghanistan and Iraq. One of his specialties was reconnaissance, where he honed his instincts and life experience to ensure the safety of his fellow SEALs before they arrived on-target. During his career he received two Bronze Stars, both with Valor, the Purple Heart, the Navy Commendation Medal, and the Navy Achievement Medal. He retired as a Chief Petty Officer.

jup_operators/jup_mp_sierra_bio:
Eyitayo \xe2\x80\x9cRipper\xe2\x80\x9d Davies is one of Operation Deadbolt\xe2\x80\x99s secret weapons. The daughter of a Londoner and a Lagosian, Eyitayo has always been a loner. Her peers thought she was quiet and shy and used that to try to bully her. Unfortunately for them, she had a knack for shutting them up with her fists. Constant fights and self-defense incidents got Eyitayo branded as a ruffian, but folks who were paying attention noticed that she never started fights. She just ended them.

As soon as she was able, Eyitayo applied for the police academy, hoping to leverage her talent for disarming people twice her size. But when all she found was paperwork and bureaucracy, she turned her sights towards the army. She applied for and was accepted into the 1 Para, a versatile airborne infantry unit where she quickly impressed both her peers and officers. While she was seen as unapproachable and intimidating, no one could doubt her ability to complete missions with ease.

Recommended despite her reclusive nature, Eyitayo joined the Special Forces Support Group (SFSG). She was deployed in operations across Europe and the Middle East, a one-man army capable of overcoming any challenge thrown at her. One of her more personally satisfying missions included supporting the SAS and the ULF in freeing Urzikstan from General Barkov. Remembering her fierceness in the battle for freedom, some of her old squad mates recruited her for Operation Deadbolt. Many of her peers still disapprove of her solitary style, but her enemies fear \xe2\x80\x9cRipper\xe2\x80\x9d as the lone wolf stalking the battlefield.

hash_57d78627790f69e6:
Felix peaked in high school. When he wasn\xe2\x80\x99t playing football, he also wasn\xe2\x80\x99t studying \xe2\x80\x93 instead you could find him glued to his collection of horror films, from the suspenseful to the grotesque. As the Captain of the football team and a certified straight A student (despite all the horror flicks), he was winning games and grades all the way through graduation. With a college scholarship in hand, he was so excited to start studying, he forgot to stop partying, and flunked out of college. Without classes or football to guide him, the real horror set in\xe2\x80\xa6 adulthood.

Unsure of his future, Felix returned to his high school as a summer camp counselor and pondered what he wanted to be now that he was all grown up. But then\xe2\x80\xa6

One eerie twilit evening, a strange man in a football helmet rampaged through the camp! He terrorized the teens and revved more than a few chainsaws, but it was none other than Felix himself who tackled him to the ground, effectively catching the killer, and saving the day.

To continue honing his skills in survival, and saving civilians, Felix enlisted in the military with the goal of one day returning to college and finishing his degree in film studies. He hopes to one day direct a film inspired by his own experiences as a camp counselor, and the infamous football helmet killer.

jup_operators/jup_mp_spring_bio:
Forged in the counterculture revolution, yet armed with drive and creative power, Tommy Chong and Cheech Marin turned cultural friction into comedic success. Facing systemic barriers with humor and cannabis, the duo exploited adversity to bring underground voices into the mainstream. Chong's ingenuity and Marin's heritage primed them for fame, while their comedic chemistry made them icons. Their albums and films exposed injustice with subversive joy, pioneering stoner comedy and becoming symbols of irreverent truth.

Marin was born in 1946 to Mexican immigrant parents in South Central Los Angeles. Facing racism and discrimination, he forged an identity through Chicano culture. While studying English, Marin nurtured his passion for performance. When Marin met Chong in Vancouver in the late 1960s, their instant chemistry was undeniable.

jup_operators/jup_mp_tango_bio:
From the heart of the Kamchatka Peninsula, Natalya \xe2\x80\x9cRaptor\xe2\x80\x9d Orlov was the unwanted daughter of a lackluster yet arrogant hunter. While her father left her to go hunting, Natalya would practice shooting with a worn rifle she had found in an abandoned lodge. Over time, she honed her skills and the rifle until both were deadly, but her father continued to dismiss her, fervently insisting she was good for nothing.

When news of a monstrous Siberian bear spread throughout her town, a teenage Natalya ventured into the forest alone, the old rifle in hand. When she returned, she triumphantly tossed the head of the beast at her father\xe2\x80\x99s feet and left town, realizing there was nothing left to prove to these little men. She traveled throughout Russia, hunting all manner of animals. Nothing came close to the thrill of the bear.

Natalya eventually found herself in Moscow, where she was scouted for her skills by the prestigious Russian special forces unit, Alpha Group. Although it was initially the promise of a paycheck that convinced Natalya to join, it wasn\xe2\x80\x99t until her first sniping assignment in Chechnya that she reconnected to the thrill of the hunt. Natalya recorded kill after kill after kill, singlehandedly holding off offensives from hundreds of feet away. \xe2\x80\x9cRaptor\xe2\x80\x9d became a legend. It was during that time that Natalya came to realize the greatest trophies did not come from hunting a bigger beast, but a smarter one: soldiers.

hash_3ec72880c4408db6:
Eric was once a man deeply in love, building a life with his soulmate Shelly. Their world was shattered when the demons of Shelly's dark past caught up with them, resulting in their brutal murder.

Resurrected and driven by vengeance, Eric was granted the supernatural powers of The Crow and could no longer die. To mark his newfound abilities, Eric used tattoo ink to make circles around his eyes and transform his face into a twisted grin \xe2\x80\x93 his haunting visage became a terrifying omen for those with guilty consciences.

Eric's presence on the battlefield is often preceded by an unsettling calm, broken only by the cawing of crows that accompany him. His experiences have left him with a profound understanding of sacrifice, love, and the lengths one must go to protect what's important. This drives Eric to use his second chance at life to make a difference in both the world of the living
and the dead.

Roland \xe2\x80\x9cSwagger\xe2\x80\x9d Kaminski of the Polish GROM is recognized as the unit\xe2\x80\x99s finest, and he is well aware of that fact. Roland was born in the Polish countryside near the outskirts of Radom, but immigrated with his family to rural France while Roland was still young. Roland loved his adoptive country but had difficulty fitting in with his peers, who taunted him that he would never truly be French. Roland committed himself to joining the French Army, convinced he\xe2\x80\x99d be accepted after serving.

After years of studying diligently, Roland was accepted into one of France\xe2\x80\x99s most prestigious military academies. Despite excelling academically and leading his class in all marks, Roland was still viewed as an outsider. An exhausted and angry Roland turned to his parents for advice, who encouraged him to go somewhere he would be valued. Roland quickly realized that that was not France and booked a flight back to Poland the next day, where he joined the army and was soon selected as a candidate for the Polish GROM, a special forces unit who welcomed him with open arms.

Now, Roland is a celebrated officer within the GROM, as talented as he is arrogant. Not only can Roland be himself among his new comrades, but he\xe2\x80\x99s recognized as their best, a claim he openly agrees with. Roland keeps pushing off retirement for when the unit doesn\xe2\x80\x99t need him anymore, a future he does not truly believes exists.

Combat diving specialist Thibault \xe2\x80\x9cRiptide\xe2\x80\x9d Lefebre was born on the French coast, in the seaside town of Biarritz. Idyllic and peaceful, the only two constants of Biarritz were the gentle ocean breeze and the town\xe2\x80\x99s affinity for surfing. While most of Thibault\xe2\x80\x99s peers adopted the sport with ease, Thibault struggled to simply stay afloat. But not one to give up, Thibault dedicated himself to surfing, eventually reaching a point where he could glide above the waves with ease.

It wasn\xe2\x80\x99t until his final year in high school that Thibault found a new obsession to work towards. When stories of a hostage situation were filling the news, Thibault found himself inspired by the combat swimmers who had saved the day. If he could teach himself to surf through sheer force of will, surely he could put that knowledge to good use to serve his country.

Practically having spent half his life in the water, Thibault worked his way up through the ranks of the French Navy and the Marine Commandos over the course of several years. He tackled his training with diligence and determination, impressing all but the most jaded of officers. Eventually he tested into the Commando Hubert, an elite combat swimming unit with operations across the globe. Now, \xe2\x80\x9cRiptide\xe2\x80\x9d works in counterterrorism and hostage rescue, pursuing his missions with the same level of effort and dedication that he\xe2\x80\x99s had his entire life.

operators/aksel_bio:
AKSEL is a modern-day Viking. Growing up in Lofoten, he was exposed to the history of his ancestors at a young age, seeing Viking culture preserved at the nearby museum. Working for his grandfather, a fisherman, Aksel loved sailing the waters of his forefathers, but he wanted to do more than just fish like the Vikings, he wanted to war like them. 

At 17, Aksel volunteered to join the Norwegian military, intent on making it into the elite ranks of the MARINEJEGERKOMMANDOEN (MJK). While he had no prior military or weapons training (aside from his weapon of choice \xe2\x80\x93 the VIKING AXE), Aksel\xe2\x80\x99s determination propelled him through selection to become an MJK operator. 

In his first deployment, Aksel was able to live out his Viking dream, but in the inverse \xe2\x80\x93 rather than conquer, he was sent to rescue the crew of an oil rig being held hostage by Somali pirates. Due to the small size of the MJK, Aksel was required to learn the full spectrum of skills \xe2\x80\x93 from diving to HALO jumping and EOD \xe2\x80\x93 but hostage rescues are his personal favorites. 

Ever on the hunt for the glory of his ancestors, there\xe2\x80\x99s not much Aksel isn\xe2\x80\x99t willing to do if it gets his blood pumping.

operators/alejandro_bio:
For over a decade, Colonel Alejandro Vargas has been a high-ranking member in The Fuerzas Especiales (Mexican Special Forces), a Tier 1 Mexican Army Special Mission counter-terror unit. Alejandro has played a major role in the Drug War, undertaking reconnaissance operations and kill or capture missions. Alejandro\xe2\x80\x99s unit, called Los Vaqueros, is the only unit in Mexico certified to operate alongside Western Special Operations Forces.

Despite being surrounded by violence, criminality and a ruthless well-funded enemy, Alejandro is an incorruptible, highly dedicated, and disciplined leader who is fiercely committed to the rule of law. Proud of his country, every day he pushes headlong into the fight for what\xe2\x80\x99s right. By not compromising his ideals, resisting, and foiling the cartels, Alejandro believes he keeps the hope for a better world alive.

Callsign Echo 3-1, Alex is a former CIA SAD ground branch asset, specialized in counter-infiltration behind enemy lines and into other denied areas. Charged with desertion after joining Farah to topple the Barkov regime in Urzikstan, his decision to fight alongside the LF proved to be the right choice.

After taking special mission assignments across the globe, Alex believes that commitment to a cause and a leader with Farah\xe2\x80\x99s dedication is where he belongs. He remains a key figure in Farah\xe2\x80\x99s Army and has taken up the mantle once held by her brother, Hadir.

operators/calisto_bio:
CALISTO ALLARD has the blood of kings in her veins. Though the direct descendant of France\xe2\x80\x99s last royal family, Calisto rebelled against the refinement of high-society, preferring to hunt, train and climb in the mountains surrounding her family\xe2\x80\x99s home. When her father threatened to cut her off, Calisto enlisted in the French Armed Services. She finished first in her class at France\xe2\x80\x99s High Mountain Military School and joined the elite Chasseurs Alpins of the 27th Mountain Infantry Brigade. 

Calisto\xe2\x80\x99s Op\xc3\xa9rations Ext\xc3\xa9rieures include missions in Ukraine, Ethiopia and the U.R.A. While participating in joint-training exercises with the American Special Forces, Calisto impressed a particular U.S. General who would like to see her involved directly in his operations. 

A skilled hunter who excels in high-altitude combat, Calisto is advanced in stealth warfare and deadly accurate across many weapons systems, including her favorite- the bow.

Jesus Ordaz learned how to adapt and survive earlier than most. Beginning his career as a soldier at just 7 years old, he was forced to work as a pajaro (lookout) for the La Ara\xc3\xb1a cartel. This was how he learned two of the most important skills in his life: keeping his eyes open and himself invisible. 

At 17, Jesus escaped the cartel and joined the military, vowing to root out corruption. His skills caught the eye of Alejandro Vargas, then a Second Captain, who encouraged him to apply for the Cuerpo de Fuerzas Especiales. He passed selection, being tasked to BLUE team, and given the name \xe2\x80\x98Chuy\xe2\x80\x99 to hide his identity.

His first operation was a raid to capture the son of La Ara\xc3\xb1a. During the operation, members of RED team turned against their own, allowing the target to escape. Betrayed by his team, Chuy left the Special Forces. He now uses his skillset to train local populations looking to combat the spread of corruption at home.

operators/conor_bio:
DECLAN O\xe2\x80\x99Conor never wanted to be in the military, but the chaos his father saw in Northern Ireland during The Troubles meant Declan didn\xe2\x80\x99t have a choice. His parents prescribed to a \xe2\x80\x9cget-tough-or-die\xe2\x80\x9d mentality and believed their son must prepare for the violent world ahead. Declan joined the Irish Defense Forces when he was 18.

However, trouble and violence followed Declan wherever he went. Physical altercations with peers and superiors were rampant. One such incident nearly sent him to Military Prison. His only saving grace was one of the men he fought \xe2\x80\x93 a Captain in the Army Ranger Wing (ARW), Ireland\xe2\x80\x99s Special Operations Force. Declan was given a choice; one he didn\xe2\x80\x99t have before \xe2\x80\x93 join the ARW or leave the military for good. This time, he chose his own path- the ARW. 

Within the special teams, Declan found purpose. His youthful aggression sharpened into a lethal discipline. He became a highly efficient operator, participating and even leading operations in Counterterrorism/Insurgency, Hostage Rescue and Special Reconnaissance.

operators/farah_bio:
Farah Karim is the founding member and leader of the Urzikstan Liberation Force. Renowned not only for leading the resistance against Russian troops, but for establishing protective units to combat terror groups throughout Urzikstan. Under Farah\xe2\x80\x99s command, civilian militias play a critical role in the fight to return their subjugated population to sovereignty and maintain their freedom.

She has learned not only operational tactics and leadership strategies, but has also navigated the complexities of international politics and policy. Farah\xe2\x80\x99s world-view draws a sharp line between herself and the enemy, refusing to engage in attacks beyond the borders of her country, believing that what distinguishes her from the terrorists and the occupiers is never crossing the line from defender to aggressor. 

To this day Farah continues to be a trusted ally and friend to Captain Price, Laswell, and all of TF141, never further than a call away from fighting their common enemies in the Middle East region.

Z\xc3\xa1szl\xc3\xb3s (Master Sergeant) Fender Takacs is the love child of U.S. Intelligence and the Cold War. Born the bastard son of an American CIA Operator and a guerilla revolutionary in Soviet Era Budapest, Fender had war in his veins.

After enlisting in the Hungarian Defense Forces at the age of 18, Fender began his military career in the 1st EOD REGIMENT out of Budapest before making his way up to the crown jewel of the HDF, the 2nd SPECIAL OPERATIONS BRIGADE. An expert in HIGH VALUE TARGETING, DEMOLITIONS and URBAN WARFARE, Fender has spent most of his career on Joint Task Forces, operating alongside U.S. SPECIAL FORCES TEAMS in some of the hottest battlegrounds across the globe including Iraq and the U.R.A.

Raised without knowing the identity of his father \xe2\x80\x93 who died before his son was born \xe2\x80\x93 Fender was told only that the man was a great American soldier, and that he, Fender, must always protect his face, which explains his custom helmet.

Kyle \xe2\x80\x9cGaz\xe2\x80\x9d Garrick, enlisted in the British Army in 2008. Within four years, he passed selection for Her Majesty\xe2\x80\x99s elite Special Air Service where he is currently rounding out a decade of service.

An expert in prime target elimination, demolitions, weapons tactics, covert surveillance and VIP protection, Gaz was conscripted into Price\xe2\x80\x99s Tier One SAS Bravo detachment after the 2019 terror attack in Piccadilly Circus.

After successful covert missions alongside Captain Price and Farah Karim\xe2\x80\x99s Liberation Force against Russia\xe2\x80\x99s General Roman Barkov in Urzikstan and Georgia, Garrick was recruited into Price\xe2\x80\x99s newly formed unit, Task Force 141.

Since 2019, Gaz and Price have been a close-knit fireteam, carrying out special missions across the globe. Under Captain Price\xe2\x80\x99s mentorship, Gaz has grown into a seasoned operator with a knack for working off the grid in hostile environments. With TF-141 shrouded in secrecy, Kyle explains\xe2\x80\x94 \xe2\x80\x9cWe move in silence, do our job, and melt away.\xe2\x80\x9d

operators/ghost_bio:
Lieutenant Simon \xe2\x80\x9cGhost\xe2\x80\x9d Riley is a British special forces operator and a commanding officer in Captain Price\xe2\x80\x99s Task Force 141. Ghost has spent much of his career serving on numerous short-term deployments, executing covert assignments in classified locations. He is an expert in clandestine fieldcraft, focused on sabotage, ambushes and infiltrations into denied areas and hazardous environments. 

Ghost is a quiet man who rarely wastes or minces words. He is adept and highly successful in executing missions alone. Ghost has spent more time behind enemy lines than most. His exploits with Captain Price\xe2\x80\x99s Bravo-6 unit are both renowned and yet classified, creating an almost mythological persona despite his reticence.

operators/graves_bio:
Commander Phillip Graves is a proud former Marine Team Chief from the MARSOC Raider Regiment. He is the founder, CEO and commander of Shadow Company, a global risk management, protection and private military firm specializing in troop, air, and maritime capability anywhere in the world.

With Shadow Co, Graves has encountered more than his fair share of success and controversy. Continuing their long affiliation with General Shepherd and hired to provide security for TF-141 in Las Almas Mexico, Grave\xe2\x80\x99s Shadow Company forces were involved in a friendly fire event that led to a now notorious \xe2\x80\x9cBlue on Blue\xe2\x80\x9d incident. 

The "mishap" sparked an FBI investigation, damaging already strained relations between the PMCs and military community, seen by some as \xe2\x80\x9ccowboys\xe2\x80\x9d and \xe2\x80\x9ctrigger happy\xe2\x80\x9d mercenaries. Commander Graves was believed KIA in the ensuing battle, but intel reports he has since reemerged, having been seen in various location in Europe and the Middle East. Graves and Shadow have never admitted responsibility for the \xe2\x80\x9cmishap\xe2\x80\x9d only adding to PMCs murky status as civilians in war zones.

operators/gromsko_bio:
For Sobies\xc5\x82aw Ko\xc5\x9bciuszko, the Polish military was a nightmare. A winged one on an armored horse. That was the image depicted in the painting in his grandmother\xe2\x80\x99s living room. The image he saw in his nightmares when he visited her. It wasn\xe2\x80\x99t until Sobies\xc5\x82aw was older, and he could understand who that rider was \xe2\x80\x93 a hussar, one of the greatest warriors in history \xe2\x80\x93 that the boy\xe2\x80\x99s nightmare became a young man\xe2\x80\x99s dream.

Determined to bring his country the glory it enjoyed in the days of the Hussars, Sobies\xc5\x82aw enlisted in the POLISH ARMED FORCES with the goal of joining the SPECIAL FORCES. While it took him a while to earn his way, eventually, Sobies\xc5\x82aw passed selection into the ranks of Poland\xe2\x80\x99s modern day hussars \xe2\x80\x93 JEDNOSTKA WOJSKOWA 2305, or the GROM (Group for Operational Maneuvering Response).

A favorite of his JTF counterparts \xe2\x80\x93 both for his loose ROE, and his extensive medical training \xe2\x80\x93 GROM Operator Sobies\xc5\x82aw Ko\xc5\x9bciuszko \xe2\x80\x93 \xe2\x80\x9cGROMSKO\xe2\x80\x9d \xe2\x80\x93 is an affable and fearless man who takes pride in his work, and his country.  The only difference between him and his winged idols, is that while the Hussar\xe2\x80\x99s strength was appearing larger than life, GROMSKO specializes in staying unseen.

GUSTAVO RODRIGUEZ, born in Costa Rica, spent his childhood on the beaches, teaching tourists to surf. One of those tourists, a US MARINE, inspired Gus with his determination, toughness, and the fact that he stood up to local members of the Las Almas cartel and lived to tell about it.

Gus was determined to join the military. Like the Marine, he wanted the skills to defend his home from the narcos. With no standing military to join, Gus opted for the next best thing - the FUERZA P\xc3\x9aBLICA, the national law enforcement agency of Costa Rica.

After years working up the ranks as a police officer, Gus was invited to join the UNIDAD ESPECIAL DE INTERVENCION (UEI). Though officially a police unit, the UEI is tasked with matters of national security, reporting directly to the Minister of the Presidency. 

With the UEI, Gus has strengthened his skills abroad, working and training with SF teams around the world. A guardian by nature, Gus specializes in hostage rescue and asset protection.

operators/heather_bio:
The daughter of paramedics and Army reservists, Ana Vega never had the opportunity to get to know her parents.  Both were killed during rescue operations in the early days of the Urzikstan conflict.

Desperate to find a connection with her fallen parents, the Gold Star child followed in their footsteps by enrolling at the prestigious West Point Academy.  It was there that her instructors regaled her with tales of her parents\xe2\x80\x99 exploits, all while Ana began writing her own story.

Graduating with top honors, she enlisted in the Army\xe2\x80\x99s Combat Medic Specialist Training Program (CMSTP) and instantly began turning heads.  Proving to be as proficient with her gun as she was her med kit, she caught the attention of her CO who recommended her for Ranger Combat Medic \xe2\x80\x93 a prestigious Special Forces unit with the 75th Ranger Regiment.

After demonstrating her worth, she became one of the first female Ranger combat medics and was later tapped for Task Force Pineapple\xe2\x80\x93 a volunteer unit designed to get US assets out of Afghanistan.  During the op, an RPG blast injured several of her unit, so Ana helped fend off the enemy while also keeping her injured squad mates alive with medical care, earning her a Combat Medical Badge.

Inspired by the op and her parents\xe2\x80\x99 sacrifice for the greater good, Ana now lends her services to more humanitarian efforts as she currently works alongside PMCs providing protection and medical care on aid missions around the globe.

There are many stories about Kim Hong-jin\xe2\x80\x99s mask. Some say it hides a deformed face. Others believe he wears it to protect the identities of his family, who could be targeted out of revenge for some of his high-profile assassinations. But the truth is much more unfortunate- Kim is a dog shit gambler. 

After falling into debt with a local crime boss, Kim fled his home and sought protection amongst the ROK ARMED FORCES. The regimented schedule and rigorous training in the army broke Kim of his selfishness and revealed a strength and skill he never knew he possessed. Years of training built Kim into a new man. He climbed the ranks of the ROK and eventually passed selection into the Special Forces, where he was assigned to the 13th SPECIAL MISSION BRIGADE. 

Mentally and physically stronger now than ever, HORANGI, as he\xe2\x80\x99s been nicknamed by his peers, still has an appetite for risk. Only these days, he\xe2\x80\x99s moved his gambles from the baccarat table to the battlefield.

HUTCH has always been good at two things \xe2\x80\x93 football, and video games. For obvious reasons (he\xe2\x80\x99s built like a tank) he was encouraged to pursue the former. 

The eldest of three, Hutch was a protective brother and a natural leader. His hard work paid off when he was awarded a scholarship to play college ball and pursue a major in computer science. However, inspired by the \xe2\x80\x9cDemon Dogs\xe2\x80\x9d capture of Al Qatala\xe2\x80\x99s leader, he chose to enlist in the Marines instead.

A physical beast, Hutch was a standout in the Corps, but his knowledge of computers uniquely qualified him as a data specialist. After 4 years of active duty, Hutch completed his service as a reservist and called for reinforcement from the Call of Duty Endowment. Utilizing CODE\xe2\x80\x99s job placement services, Hutch began a competitive career in cyber security. 

It wasn\xe2\x80\x99t long, however, before he learned his beloved Corps was establishing the Marine Corps Forces Cyberspace Command (MARFORCYBER).  It was the perfect call for Hutch to return to active duty.

operators/klaus_bio:
Klaus Fisker, grew up in the village of N\xc3\xb8debo, Denmark. From an early age, he was taught to forage, fish, and live off the forests around Lake Esrum. It wasn\xe2\x80\x99t long before his interests turned to the world beyond his home, and on his 17th birthday, he had his father sign consent forms for military service.

His upbringing made him a natural soldier, helping him excel in all aspects of training, particularly night-time exercises, including navigation. Klaus later learned he was born with exceptional scotopic vision \xe2\x80\x93 \xe2\x80\x9cnatural night vision\xe2\x80\x9d.

At age 22, Klaus passed selection into Denmark\xe2\x80\x99s Elite Special Forces. There, he participated in operations all around the globe- from hunting pirates off the coast of Somalia, to tracking war criminals in the Balkan Peninsula, and eventually raiding high-level terrorist safehouses in the mountains of Al-Mazrah.

Known for his professionalism, optimism, and his sweet-tooth, Klaus remains one of the most respected and admired operators on active-duty today.

Born to a blue-collar family in Athens, Kleo had high-expectations from birth, being named after the legendary queen of Egypt. Though encouraged by her parents to prioritize education, it seemed fate had other plans, as the Greek Financial Crisis led to her enlisting in the Hellenic Armed Forces to help her family. 

Kleo\xe2\x80\x99s athleticism instantly set her apart from her peers. The training she received unlocked a drive and determination she never knew existed, propelling her through selection of the ZETA AMPHIBIOUS RAIDERS SQUADRON (Z\xe2\x80\x99MAK), a Tier-1 Special Operations Unit specializing in maritime operations. 

Though she entered it out of necessity, the military taught Kleo who she really was: a warrior. Refusing further promotion, Kleo chose to continue fighting in the trenches. A feared and respected soldier, Kleo\xe2\x80\x99s \xe2\x80\x9cGREEN EYES OF HADES\xe2\x80\x9d have become legendary across the Aegean and beyond \xe2\x80\x93 the last thing her enemies see before they leave this world.

K\xc3\xb6nig (age unknown) suffers from severe social anxiety. Unfortunately for him, it\xe2\x80\x99s hard to go unnoticed when you\xe2\x80\x99re the size of a mountain.

Bullied as a child, K\xc3\xb6nig found acceptance only when fighting \xe2\x80\x93 an activity at which he excelled. After volunteering for the military at 17, K\xc3\xb6nig was selected to an elite commando unit. While he\xe2\x80\x99d hoped to join as a recon sniper, his physical size made him a poor candidate. Instead, he was assigned as an insertion specialist, serving as a human-battering ram to charge through doors in the most contested environments.

An expert in urban-warfare, counter-terrorism and hostage rescue, K\xc3\xb6nig once singlehandedly took down an AQ human-trafficking cell when he breached the building and, taking point for his team, proceeded to eliminate all twelve of the combatants inside. While the sniper hood concealing his face makes him a terrifying figure, it\xe2\x80\x99s rumored what\xe2\x80\x99s under that hood is even scarier.

operators/luna_bio:
Ze Mingzhu, 31, born in Fairfax, Virginia, is the middle-child of a first-generation Singaporean family. Excelling in school, she was offered a multitude of scholarships, including West Point Military Academy in New York.

After graduating with honors, Mingzhu enlisted in the Army and passed selection for Special Forces. She served two tours overseas, fighting alongside members of the CIA\xe2\x80\x99s Special Activities Center (SAC). Witnessing the capabilities the Agency had, she applied immediately upon returning home.

Mingzhu worked as a liaison for allied-nation intelligence organizations, like Britain\xe2\x80\x99s MI-6. After the London terror attacks in 2019, she was crucial in tracking down the Al-Qatala cell responsible. Those involved gave her the nickname \xe2\x80\x9cLuna\xe2\x80\x9d - a light in the dark. 

Wanting more of a direct-action/combat role, \xe2\x80\x9cLuna\xe2\x80\x9d refused a promotion, instead transitioning to the SAC\xe2\x80\x99s Ground Branch. There she worked in the darkest corners of the globe, bringing enemies into the light.

operators/mace_bio:
Mace is a former Special Forces Army Ranger turned PMC, serving under Commander Philip Graves as part of Shadow Company. Yet, after multiple deployments and countless operations, Mace became fatigued with the way of war. The operator known for his brutal and brash tactics on the battlefield looked to turn over a new leaf in his ancestral home of Africa. 
It was there Mace ran his own unit of PMCs, conducting numerous aid missions to several impoverished communities.  However, the warfare he left behind quickly caught up to him. Warlords in the region, funded by the Konni Group, launched attacks on his squad and those he aimed to help.
Outnumbered and outgunned, Mace was left with few options. That is, until his old Commander tracked him down. Graves proposed a simple offer: join Shadow, bring the fight to Konni, and sever the warlord's lifeline. Mace was more than willing to accept.

NOVA BROWN has aviation warfare in her blood. Since her grandmother, an American WASP (Women Airforce Service Pilot), met her grandfather, a Royal Air Force Fighter Pilot, in WW2, every generation of Nova\xe2\x80\x99s family has flown in the RAF. While the path was never forced on her, Nova\xe2\x80\x99s natural desire to fly was one she couldn\xe2\x80\x99t deny since her mother first brought her into the cockpit.  

A gifted pilot with an instinct to protect, Nova earned her tougher-than-nails reputation in OPERATION SHADER. Risking her own aircraft to protect her wingman, Nova was forced to eject deep in enemy territory. Using her SERE (Survival, Evasion, Resistance and Escape) training, she fashioned a HATCHET out of pieces of her downed jet, and made her way back to a SpecGru FOB. The feat was so impressive, it got Nova recruited into another branch of service \xe2\x80\x93 the 42 COMMANDO.

Exhibiting the same skill and grit on land as in the sky, Nova is at her happiest leading missions for the 42\xe2\x80\x99s L COMPANY, a team focused on rescuing downed airmen.
