operators/oni_bio:
Hiro \xe2\x80\x9cOni\xe2\x80\x9d Watanabe\xe2\x80\x99s story is one forged in the same tumultuous fires as that of his ancestors\xe2\x80\x99 sacred family daisho blades. Descended from a century\xe2\x80\x99s old samurai clan \xe2\x80\x93 Oni\xe2\x80\x99s family fell on hard times once the samurai were disbanded in 1871, forcing them into poverty and desperation. By the time Oni was born, the Watanabe clan had all but abandoned their once great heritage and forsaken their family name, joining the ranks of a crime syndicate.

As a child, Oni didn\xe2\x80\x99t see much of his father, Akira, an established Oyabun (absolute leader) of his own crime syndicate. And since his mother perished during childbirth, this left the majority of Oni\xe2\x80\x99s upbringing in the hands of his grandfather, Tatsuki. Tatsuki, for his part, wanted nothing to do with the ways of the crime syndicate. He was a pragmatic man who believed in the old samurai code and his forefathers were once dutybound to. Early on, Tatsuki would regale young Oni with tales of their ancestors\xe2\x80\x99 legendary exploits on the battlefield. It was through these stories that Oni developed his unshakable code of honor and would seek to bring his family name back to prominence.
By his 17th birthday, Oni\xe2\x80\x99s father had begun grooming him to join the ranks of the syndicate. Not wanting to follow in his father\xe2\x80\x99s footsteps, Oni refused the path before him, leaving in the dead of night, with nothing but the clothes on his back- and the hallowed daisho blades for protection.

With nowhere else to go, and in need of a fresh start, the 17-year-old entered the Japanese self defense force using a fake identity to allow him passage into the military early, but to also shield him from his father and the crime syndicate. Thanks in part to his grandfather\xe2\x80\x99s teachings and training, Oni quickly rose the ranks of the Japanese self defense force, eventually garnering the attention of his superiors, who were looking for promising soldiers to splinter off into their new elite special forces unit called the SOG (Special Operations Group). This faction would train exclusively with American Green Berets and Delta Forces to provide Japan with something they hadn\xe2\x80\x99t had since the samurai disbanded over a century ago \xe2\x80\x93 elite special operators capable of running with their counterparts across the globe.

Oni was a born warrior, vastly exceeding the prowess of his counterparts in the program and eventually commanding his own unit. But after countless missions and commendations displaying his valor and courage abroad, Oni hungered to come back to Japan and do what his ancestors had done all those years ago \xe2\x80\x93 protect and fight the threats on the home front - all while trying to reestablish his family\xe2\x80\x99s good name. Back home, Oni was quickly welcomed into Japan\xe2\x80\x99s elite national counter terrorism unit the SAT (Special Assault Team). It was a move that would directly pit him against his father, who had now climbed the ranks of the crime syndicate. Through the power and influence of his father, Oni was dishonorably discharged from his post.

Oni now acts as a gun for hire as he vows to continue the fight against his father and anyone who should cross the samurai code for that matter, in the hopes that one day, he can restore the Watanabe name back to prominence.

operators/price_bio:
John Price has spent most of his career with the 22nd Special Air Service Regiment fighting in the shadows. He is a veteran of military operations in nearly every conflict-prone corner of the world. He is a man of few words, but his words always count. He knows the rules, reads from the back of the book and is willing to break ranks and violate orders to get the job done.

Sometimes unpredictable and unrestrained, John Price has a golden rule all his own: \xe2\x80\x9cCut heads off snakes. No matter who, no matter where\xe2\x80\xa6\xe2\x80\x9d Specializing in unconventional warfare, the Captain is a target focused war fighter who deploys a cut to the chase lethality.

In 2019, with the help of CIA Station Chief Kate Laswell and the oversight of General Shepherd- under the Five Eyes Alliance, Captain Price stood up a new unit he called Task Force 141. This covert Joint Operations squadron is on call to mobilize anywhere in the world with immediate readiness.

operators/reyes_bio:
Reyes grew up in northwestern Alberta, spending most of his time hunting and trapping in the cragged terrain of the Caribou mountains. He often missed school, instead preferring an education from those he considers life\xe2\x80\x99s greatest teachers: history and experience.

An avid history buff, Reyes regaled himself with the military tactics and prowess of Caesar, Napoleon, Shingen, and Barca, learning how small teams with strong tactics could conquer armies.

Reyes joined the military early, lying about his age and forging signatures to get accepted. He was accepted to the Canadian Special Operations Regiment (CSOR), though was rolled back due to locking horns with his instructors over proper tactics.

After multiple tours in the Al Mazrah & Urzikstan region, Reyes set his sights on small-unit, Tier-1 teams. He left CSOR in 2020, and, officially, that\xe2\x80\x99s where his military career ends. However, Reyes now operates with multi-national \xe2\x80\x9cdeniable forces\xe2\x80\x9d, fighting on the frontlines of wars the world will never know.

operators/ronin_bio:
An ex-Special Forces officer, Daniel Shinoda\xe2\x80\x99s skills in unconventional warfare were highly sought after during the Verdansk conflict. In 2019, the \xe2\x80\x9cone-man-army\xe2\x80\x9d volunteered for ARMISTICE, a multi-national force that opposed emerging threats in the region. He believed this force would restore balance to the war-ravaged lands and was the master he could serve. Instead, he saw it descend into chaos.

After the fall of Armistice, different factions fought over the remnants of territory, equipment, and ordnance. It wasn\xe2\x80\x99t long before their wars were spilling into neighboring areas such as Urzikstan/Al-Mazrah. As a masterless mercenary, Ronin took it upon himself, using his skills in reconnaissance and sabotage, to maintain balance between these factions.

In this way, Ronin has finally found the master he can serve, one that cannot be corrupted: balance, itself.
operators/ronin_western_5_desc: Get on a bike and ride with this ^3Operator Skin^7.

\xe2\x80\x95 Miyamoto Musashi, The Book of Five Rings

operators/roze_bio:
Rozlin \xe2\x80\x9cRoze\xe2\x80\x9d Helms grew up in the Colorado mountains and became one of the first women ever to graduate from the Army Ranger School. Proficient in small-unit tactics and close combat engagements, Roze had found her profession, or so she thought. It wasn\xe2\x80\x99t long before she and the military machine cut ties, leaving a well-trained warrior with few choices.

Linking up with a former colleague, Roze joined The Jackals, a well-funded, non-governmental organization (NGO) focused on eliminating Al-Qatala influence in the Pan-African region. In 2020, a new opportunity came knocking at her door. It was Philip Graves, Commander of Shadow Company. The contract offered was simple: help restore order in Verdansk.

Unseen forces had different plans for Verdansk, however, and after it fell in the wake of Zakhaev\xe2\x80\x99s death, Shadow Company faced its own set of challenges. Roze ended her contract in early 2022 and aligned with the KorTac group. Her skills keep her a highly sought-after operator in a post-asymmetric warfare world.

operators/soap_bio:
The Scottish born, Johnny \xe2\x80\x9cSoap\xe2\x80\x9d MacTavish, is a fearless, self assured and instinctive hard-charger. He remains the youngest candidate to pass SAS selection in Royal Army history. He earned the nickname \xe2\x80\x9cSoap\xe2\x80\x9d for cleaning house with remarkable speed and accuracy in room clearance techniques and urban warfare tactics. He is competitive, daring and always looking for a win.

Soap is a trained sniper and demolitions expert, often operating in isolation and under pressure, performing critically timed activities in support of clandestine missions. He is a risk taker, a fierce competitor and a fighter in every sense of the word.

Soap has spent the last several years carrying out both covert and overt operations around the world. In 2019, he was chosen to be part of Captain Price\xe2\x80\x99s newly formed elite special operations unit known as Task Force 141.

In 2023, Soap was KIA responding to a terror attack in the London Chunnel led by Vladimir Makarov and his Konni group soldiers.

operators/stiletto_bio:
Headstrong and vindictive, STILETTO became a cop for one reason \xe2\x80\x93 revenge. Already marked with the scar that splits her face, her fellow officers at the Gendarmerie never learned how she came to acquire it, or her intimate knowledge of Italy\xe2\x80\x99s organized crime network, the CAMORRA. Stiletto told them only that her war was a personal one. As a member of the Carabinieri\xe2\x80\x99s Anti-Mafia/Anti-Drug Task Forces, Stiletto earned a reputation as a fearless door-kicker more than willing to get her hands dirty.

As her personal vendetta against the Camorra \xe2\x80\x93 in particular, heroin traffickers \xe2\x80\x93 grew across the boot of Italy, it eventually pulled her into the GLOBAL WAR ON DRUGS. Realizing that she needed to attack her country\xe2\x80\x99s drug problem at its source \xe2\x80\x93 its supply \xe2\x80\x93 Stiletto volunteered to train foreign police forces in IRAQ, AFGHANISTAN, and LAS ALMAS.

An expert in urban-warfare, Stiletto is skilled in CQC and surgical with her preferred weapon of choice \xe2\x80\x93 a stiletto switchblade.

operators/valeria_bio:
El Sin Nombre (Valeria Garza) is the elusive leader of a powerful international trafficking organization operating out of Mexico known as the Las Almas cartel. Under Valeria\xe2\x80\x99s leadership, Las Almas has become notorious for their expertise in smuggling, funneling tons of narcotics into the US and Europe each year, with influence stretching over 6 continents. She has expanded the cartel\xe2\x80\x99s reach to operate protective \xe2\x80\x9cservices\xe2\x80\x9d, assassinations,\xc2\xa0extortion and for-profit kidnappings, operating smuggling and trafficking lanes across the globe.

Valeria has focused on forging unholy alliances with unlikely partners all over the world, not only to advance her business, but aligning herself with crime and terror syndicates gives her organization leverage and intelligence on a worldwide scale.

operators/zero_bio:
SAMI ZAKARIA, the youngest child of a wealthy Egyptian family, lived a charmed life. He spent his days at country clubs and his evenings at nightclubs. He lived only for the moment, and himself. Then one night, a terrorist attack shattered his privileged world. While he was lucky enough to survive the blast, his sisters were not. Sami was left wallowing in guilt, until his uncle \xe2\x80\x93 a colonel in the EGYPTIAN ARMED FORCES \xe2\x80\x93 suggested that Sami go out and do something about the pain he felt. 

Taking his uncle\xe2\x80\x99s advice, Sami enlisted in the EGYPTIAN ARMED FORCES. There, he sought to atone for his guilt by dedicating himself to protecting others. He was so driven by this pursuit that he was invited to join Egypt\xe2\x80\x99s premier fighting force, the EL- SA\xe2\x80\x99KA FORCES, where he was assigned to TASK FORCE 777, the counter-terrorism unit.

A serious and self-less man, \xe2\x80\x9cZero\xe2\x80\x9d earned his nickname for the recalibration of his values, and the regard he has for his own life.

operators/zeus_bio:
ZOSAR KALU was born in Edo State, in the South-Niger-Delta, to a middle-class family. The eldest of three children, he helped raise his younger siblings, while his parents pursued dreams of high-office. His younger brother, born with Dysarthria (a speech disorder), would pronounce his name \xe2\x80\x9cZeus\xe2\x80\x9d. His family found this fitting and adopted it.

After graduating university, Zeus served in the National Youth Service Corps. Stationed in Makurdi, he quickly became enthralled with a Special Forces Battalion, seeing them work with Western militaries to combat Al-Qatala. Because of this, his service year became a service career.

As Zeus rose through the ranks in Special Forces, so did his family in the political world. During the election for Minister of Justice, a local AQ cell attacked the voter center, killing over 50 people- his family included. Now the last of his name, Zeus established the \xe2\x80\x9cThunder\xe2\x80\x9d Corps, a counter-terrorism group dedicated to hunting AQ wherever they hide and bringing them to justice.
operators/zeus_eastern_b_desc: Olympus and all that it surveys is yours to rule.

operators/zimo_bio:
Zh\xc3\xacqi\xc3\xa1ng Hu\xc3\xa1ng (20s) was born to be a soldier. Raised as a member of the working class in the industrial city of Ti\xc4\x81nj\xc4\xabn, Zh\xc3\xacqi\xc3\xa1ng followed the footsteps of his grandmother, who fought in the trenches of the Chinese Civil War, and enlisted in the armed forces. Like her, Zh\xc3\xacqi\xc3\xa1ng wanted to fight for the side of righteousness \xe2\x80\x93 the side of the people. And in this increasingly global and tech-driven world, he felt the best way to do so, was to join the most globally impactful branch of the world\xe2\x80\x99s largest army. 

As a cadet, Zh\xc3\xacqi\xc3\xa1ng was selected to join a Tier 1 special operations unit. With the largest land-based missile arsenal in the world, the majority of Zh\xc3\xacqi\xc3\xa1ng\xe2\x80\x99s early experience was securing bases in country. But increasingly, he\xe2\x80\x99s been tasked with defending munitions transports and facilities globally.

An incorruptible idealist, \xe2\x80\x9cZimo\xe2\x80\x9d is willing to sacrifice himself for the greater good \xe2\x80\x93 the people.

operators/zoltan_bio:
Growing up in Central Florida, Osmond \xe2\x80\x9cOz\xe2\x80\x9d Ryan was an outsider since the day he was born. Having few family and fewer friends, Osmond frequently escaped to the online world, where he went by the handle "Oz".

A self-taught "grey-hat" hacker, Oz\xe2\x80\x99s idea of fun was attempting to find exploits and weaknesses in the world\xe2\x80\x99s most secure servers, and provide security fixes...for a price. This caught the interest of the Army's high brass, most notably General Shepherd. Though contracted with the US Army Cyber Command (ARCYBER), Oz would unofficially be working for Shepherd's private military group, Shadow Company. It was within this group that Oz learned to fight on both the physical and digital front lines.

The weight of the decision was magnified when, in 2022, Commander Graves found himself embroiled in a troubling "blue on blue" incident that remained under investigation. Recognizing Oz's unwavering loyalty and cyber skills, Graves entrusted him with the role of de facto leader of Shadow Company. Oz's mission was twofold: to meticulously manage the narratives surrounding the incident and to coordinate the mercenary activities necessary to ensure Shadow Company's global presence and effectiveness in ongoing conflicts. It was a difficult choice for Oz, one that challenged his sense of loyalty and duty but he delivered.
